reviews.title: It’s kind of good
reviews.text: I have used many different calorie trackers and there are things I like and dislike about this one. I do love that i typically can scan and it will find any food. I also like I can measure in grams.. but the food meal scanner is HORRIBLE. Not once has it gotten what was on my plate correct. Not once! And I’ve used other apps that the food scan is amazing. So for that, I am only giving it three stars. Because I do like how much time it saves being able to just scan my food instead of individually typing in each ingredients.

reviews.title: Customer Support???
reviews.text: I'm really not happy that I cannot get anyone in customer support to email me back with answers to my questions. This is the second time that I've signed up for this app and I am finding a lot of things that I scan are coming back incorrect. Things that I search are coming back with inaccurate information as far as nutrition. If I have to Google and get more accurate information what is the point of this app? There really needs to be away to edit inaccurate information even if it's just 1g off on protein or 10g more carbs than the food item is. I also don't like that the app doesn't take into consideration fiber when counting net carbs. Also, why isn't it possible to delete recently logged instead of having a grow to infinity? Where is the help for these issues?

reviews.title: Micronutrient Addition and a few notes
reviews.text: The app is great, the UI is easy to understand and the layout is very beginner friendly. I love the protein, carb and fat layout but a few suggestions: we should be able to see micronutrients too at least fiber, iron and vitamins as these nutrients are also important to people that track their meals. Additionally, when we add/create new food items we need to be able to put the serving size in g instead of just oz/fl oz and we should be able to put the actual weight instead of the approximates of 0.25,0.3,etc. if the developers can take this into account the app will be five star.

reviews.title: Completely Unusable + Poor Support
reviews.text:
I was a paid version user until now. The app is entirely non-responsive — I can’t tap or interact with anything, making it unusable.

Support was equally disappointing. Despite explaining the issue clearly and confirming I had already tried basic troubleshooting, I received a generic, dismissive response that didn’t address the problem at all.

If an app doesn’t work and support won’t actually help, there’s no reason to keep it. I’ve already switched to a better alternative.
